response_quality_semantics: A burned-pilot spatial block is response-qualified only when it contains at least one source-designated complete vascular-plant inventory and retains at least the frozen minimum_test_rows applicable targets under the single fixed pilot-supported species universe. That species universe is defined once from burned-pilot response only as species with native code N in at least two distinct frozen pilot spatial blocks, then applied identically to every pilot block. Atolls missing frozen R0/R1 safe covariates were excluded before response access. Empty catalogues/species support are non-estimable; blocks may not be rescued, merged, substituted, imputed, or have thresholds lowered after pilot opening.
